generatedProse.practice-connection:
From here, these genres are the working documents of your own research. In any subject, a dissertation opens with a literature review; a study begins as a proposal a supervisor or an ethics panel approves; findings are written up as a report. Each time you write one to its purpose, rather than merely to its format, you are doing the work that research is built on.

That habit carries into professional life. Wherever you gather evidence, make a case from it, and set it down for others to judge, the same three moves are at work. The genres you have just learned to see are ones you will use long after you graduate.
